source_signals: agent-lab-package.zip: learning/ (routing, ledger, eval, runs/*/telemetry, regress), reports/ (20), agents, skills, scripts. learning/signals.json is stale (RUN-001..007 only), so most proposals cite file:line evidence instead of SIG ids.
ranking_method: rank = expected gain / effort (S=1, M=2, L=3). Gains are computed from package numbers where marked 'computed', otherwise labelled 'estimate'. Not the CAWL EV formula.
held_out_note: cm-01..03 have already been held-out cases for 3 roles / 4 bundles; prefer a fresh capability case (AL-10) where the eval_plan says so. Advice only: NEXUS tests locally and applies only on ACCEPT.

change.text: (1) grade.mjs emits a per-defect x rep detection and severity matrix. (2) gate computes discordant pairs (detected in one arm's rep i, not the other's) and an exact two-sided sign test; ACCEPT on recall/severity needs p <= 0.05 (>= 6/6, 8/9 or 9/10 discordant pairs in one direction) pooled over cases AND the same sign on >= 2 cases; otherwise PROVISIONAL at best. (3) ledger row stores sha256 of KEY.json/DECOYS.json, written before the first rep; gate refuses if the hash changed. Skill line: 'Prefer more cases over more reps: 3 cases x 1-2 reps beats 1 case x 3 reps.'

evidence: learning/ledger.jsonl:10 (cm-03 ACCEPT on +0.067 = 2 detections in 9 defect-rep slots, paired_agree:false)
learning/ledger.jsonl:15 (dorn cm-01 severity +0.125 = one defect re-rated per rep)
learning/runs/CM-SOLO-V1/RESULT.md:19-21 (detector edits after baseline; tolerance fix after candidate reports were seen)
proposals.root_cause: Absolute thresholds (recall 0.02, severity 0.05) are smaller than the score step of one defect, and reps of one case are not independent evidence of a general gain.
proposals.expected_effect: Fewer accepted changes that do not generalise; number unknown. Estimate: some of the 5 ACCEPT rows would become PROVISIONAL.
proposals.risk: Medium: stricter gate = slower learning; mitigated by AL-10 (more cases) and by keeping PROVISIONAL as an Owner-decidable state.
proposals.eval_plan: Retro-replay the new gate on all 15 ledger rows using stored per-rep data (where per-defect detail exists in state/grading). Report which verdicts change. 0 model tokens.
